import copy, json
from work import evaluate

cases = [
 ({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':2}]}, {'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':False}, {'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':2}],'errors':[]}),
 ({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':-1,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'a','amount':True},{'id':'b','amount':1,'unit':'bad'}]}, {'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1},'unique':False}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'unit'}]}),
 ({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':-1},{'id':'a','amount':2},{'id':'a','amount':3}]}, {'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1},'unique':True}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'duplicate'}]}),
 ({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'b','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'c','amount':-float('inf')}]}, {'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1},'unique':False}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'}]}),
 ({'rows':[{'id':'huge','amount':10**1000}]}, {'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1},'unique':False}, {'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'huge','amount':10**1000}],'errors':[]}),
 ({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':1,'unit':[]}]}, {'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1},'unique':False}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'unit'}]}),
 ({'rows':[None,{'id':'ok','amount':0}]}, {'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1},'unique':False}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'}]})
]
for req, pol, expected in cases:
 before = (copy.deepcopy(req), copy.deepcopy(pol))
 got = evaluate(req, pol)
 assert got == expected, (got, expected)
 assert (req, pol) == before
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report == [evaluate(req, policy) for req in requests]
print('all validation and report checks passed')
